summary: Nike home shirt launched 9 July 2026: Volkswagen on the front (the pro teams wore the new all-electric VW ID. Polo lettering on the chest at the start of the season) and Mobileye on the left sleeve (sleeve partner since 2025/26). The club shop product page names only these two shirt sponsors plus the Nike swoosh; no back or shorts sponsor is named.
